messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — high error rates observed from the routing service -> 5xx spike across eu-central-1 to customers using dedicated and private deployments. auto-escalation to oncall-rotation.

oncall-rotation: taking this — I'm booting the playbook and attaching logs. pinging @mira_chen for SHADOW region checks.

alex_nguyen: saw the alert, confirming: traffic is showing sustained 25% 5xx at the load-balancer layer. latency slightly elevated too.

mira_chen: looking at instance metrics now. KV cache thrash looks suspicious. could be a mem pressure/regression from yesterday's runtime tweak.

sre_pager: paging exec: @sam_csm and @elaine_support please standby — we may need customer-facing comms for enterprise customers.

ops-lead: quick decision: open incident channel, start status page draft, prepare tailored notices for top-tier accounts. we should prioritize customers on dedicated and private.

alex_nguyen: attaching quick logs dump:
```
# tail -n 200 /var/log/routing/2026-07-15.log | grep ERROR | head
2026-07-15T09:12:33Z routing svc: kvcache miss flood, alloc fail
2026-07-15T09:12:35Z runtime: ephemeral OOM while handling request
2026-07-15T09:12:37Z grpc: downstream error: code=13 desc="internal"
```

mira_chen: confirmed memory pressure on pool-3. rolling restart of pool-3 nodes to reclaim cache and ensure KV eviction. starting canary restart on two nodes.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0715-01. Severity: SEV2. SLA impact: degraded throughput for enterprise dedicated customers in eu-central-1.

alex_nguyen: mitigation plan: 1) canary restart, 2) revert last runtime patch if instability continues, 3) route affected enterprise traffic to secondary region as fallback while we stabilize.

sre_pager: deploying canary restart now. ETA 5m for canary health check.

mira_chen: canary looks green on two nodes after restart. memory utilization dropping, KV hit rate recovering.

ops-lead: good. prepare status page update and customer notices. @sam_csm / @elaine_support, below is curated impact + routing table — please confirm contact assignments before we send.

alex_nguyen: AFFECTED ENTERPRISE ACCOUNTS (dedicated / private deployments) — curated list for targeted notifications:
- NovaCare Health (acct_id: AC-7732) — dedicated-eu cluster
- Meridian Fintech (acct_id: AC-9011) — private-vpc eu-central-1
- Arbour Analytics (acct_id: AC-6120) — dedicated-eu cluster
- BeaconRetail (acct_id: AC-4490) — private-vpc eu-central-1
- LumenPay EU (acct_id: AC-5512) — dedicated-eu cluster

sam_csm: confirming outreach assignments:
- NovaCare Health -> sam_csm primary, elaine_support fallback
- Meridian Fintech -> elaine_support primary, ops-lead fallback
- Arbour Analytics -> sam_csm primary
- BeaconRetail -> elaine_support primary
- LumenPay EU -> sam_csm primary

elaine_support: I will draft targeted email copy with impact statement and recommended actions.

alex_nguyen: CUSTOMER IMPACT (short, tailored):
- Symptom: intermittent 5xx errors and elevated latency for inference/routing calls; observed primarily in eu-central-1 on dedicated/private deployments. Failure rate peaked ~25% and is now trending down after canary restarts.
- Scope: limited to listed enterprise accounts and some additional smaller dedicated instances; hosted API customers unaffected.
- Mitigation: rolling restarts restored node health for canary; fallback routing to secondary region available if errors recur; team monitoring 24/7 until full recovery.

ops-lead: STATUS PAGE (short blurb for public page):
- Title: Degraded routing/inference performance in eu-central-1 — mitigation in progress
- Body: We are investigating intermittent 5xx errors affecting dedicated and private deployments in eu-central-1. A targeted mitigation (canary node restarts) has been deployed and initial signs show recovery. We will provide updates every 30 minutes until fully resolved. No action is required for hosted API users. INC-2026-0715-01.

sam_csm: DRAFT CUSTOMER NOTIFICATION (email / high-touch) — please review:
"Hello <FirstName>,

We wanted to make you aware of a service disruption affecting some Dedicated/Private deployments in our eu-central-1 region. You may experience intermittent 5xx errors or higher latency for inference requests. Our engineers have deployed targeted mitigations and are monitoring; most customers are observing reduced error rates after restarts.

Affected resources: <list specific cluster IDs for your account>
Estimated impact window: ongoing; monitoring.
Recommended action: None required; if you see persistent errors, we can failover your traffic to a secondary region. Please reply to this thread or contact your CSM directly.

We will keep you updated.

— Redwood Inference Support
"

elaine_support: I'll add account-specific cluster IDs and send via our high-touch comms flow. tagging legal for customer notice copy review: @ops-lead (for visibility).

mira_chen: ops update: continuing to watch metrics. KV hit ratio normalized to 92% on canary nodes. No further OOMs observed in last 10m.

incident-bot: Update logged: mitigation step "canary restart" succeeded. Monitoring in progress.

alex_nguyen: internal comms template for execs (short):
- Summary: partial degradation in eu-central-1 affecting dedicated/private customers; canary restarts restored node health; targeted customers identified and CSMs assigned; monitoring until full recovery.
- Ask: itinerary for next 2 hours: 30m status page update, customer notifications sent within 45m, readiness to failover traffic if errors reappear.

sre_pager: oncall handoff: @mira_chen will take lead for next shift. I'll update escalations and handover notes in the incident doc.

mira_chen: taking handoff — notes added to the runbook. continuing watch, will escalate to rollback if error rate >10% for next 15m.

ops-lead: thanks everyone. Sam/elaine, confirm when customer notices are out and paste copy here. We'll update status page at next scheduled interval.

sam_csm: sending NovaCare Health + LumenPay now. Meridian Fintech scheduled after we attach cluster IDs.

elaine_support: BeaconRetail and Arbour notices queued. will post updates here once delivered.

alex_nguyen: postmortem checklist items added to INC-2026-0715-01. keep this channel for operations-only updates; escalate external coord to #customer-comms if needed.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0715-01 updated by alex_nguyen — severity remains SEV2; next update in 30m.
